messages:
sera: FYI deploybot raised a soft-pin for quant-v5b in ap-southeast-1 due to repeated kvcache evict-index drift on long sessions (>4k). proposing regional soft-pin + float fallback.
deploybot: ALERT: compatibility-check failure detected for model 'quant-v5b' with runtime '2.18' in ap-southeast-1. Suggested action: apply regional soft-pin to runtime 2.17. Error rate: 4.9% on longseq tests.
yan: any stacktrace or small repro? want to see if checksum mismatch or memory corruption.
lucas: snippet from the repro harness:
```
[2026-03-23T23:11:02Z] kernelA: kvcache evict idx mismatch shard=5 expected=16384 got=16352
[2026-03-23T23:11:02Z] model quant-v5b: attention_state checksum mismatch
```
eng-runtime: looking like an eviction race when seq crosses a 4096-window boundary. i'll instrument the kernel with semaphore traces and run longseq harness.
product: product note: if soft-pin remains >12h we'll need to publish a short customer FYI and update release notes under "regional fallbacks."
sre-oncall: routing new sessions to f32 fallback will increase apac 95p by ~45ms. I've put alerts: ap-southeast-1 quant-v5b errors >1% for 5m -> pager; 95p latency >180ms -> pager.
sera: action plan: 1) soft-pin regionally (12h), 2) route new sessions to f32 fallback only, 3) eng-runtime to reproduce + patch, 4) test patch in eu-canary, 5) lift pin when green. agree?
yan: +1 regional only. global rollback would be disruptive.
eng-runtime: ETA for debug branch + ci-canary run: ~2.5h. will report PR id in-thread.
lucas: prepping fallback pool and autoscale pre-warm. ETA 20m.
deploybot: Pin created by sera -> pin_id=pin_4450007777. Scope: region ap-southeast-1. Target: runtime:2.17. TTL: 12h. Mode: soft. Audit: user=sera.
product: drafting changelog blurb: "APAC: temporary routing to float variant for quant-v5b to ensure correctness on long sequences; regional soft-pin applied." will share for review.
sre-oncall: added guard: auto-unpin after TTL unless extended. Pager if unpin occurs with no owner note.
yan: once eng-runtime posts PR with deterministic reproducer we'll decide whether to extend TTL to 24h.
sera: logging action items in release tracker and tagging eng-runtime. will update this thread with repro confirmation or metrics changes. :white_check_mark:
